title: Importance Of Hiring NATE Certified HVAC Technicians
desc: Are you curious to learn about the importance of hiring NATE certified technicians? Call the experts at Rosenberg Indoor Comfort today!

blocks.text: North American Technician Excellence certification is the highest level of certification a technician can achieve. Most states don’t require technicians to have NATE certification, so you’ll have to check whether a particular company hires NATE-certified technicians.

If you want the best-qualified technician working on your heating and cooling system, then you should choose a company that employs NATE-certified technicians. You’re virtually guaranteed a positive experience every time you turn to NATE-certified technicians to repair, install, or tune-up your indoor comfort systems. They’re required to pass more difficult tests than state licensure exams. Technicians seeking NATE certification also receive expert training.
NATE-Certified Technicians Are More Likely to Fix Problems the First Time

Many homeowners feel anxious about choosing a repair company because they don’t want to have to call a new business if the problem wasn’t correctly fixed. You can have confidence that your heating or cooling system will be correctly fixed when you choose a company that has NATE-certified technicians. They had to pass rigorous tests to earn their NATE certification, so they have extensive knowledge of heating and cooling systems.

Technicians who have NATE certification must also receive ongoing training to stay up to date with the latest information on HVAC systems. They’re trained to repair all makes and models, too. They’re also capable of spotting and repairing the less common problems that heating and cooling systems experience.

Rosenberg Plumbing & Air is a heating and cooling company in San Antonio, TX, that employs NATE-certified technicians. Our company is also a member of the ACCA (Air Conditioning Contractors of America), and we won the Angie’s List Super Service Award in 2016. You can trust us for quality service.
Your Heating and Cooling System Will Be Correctly Installed
We’ve come across many heating and cooling systems that were incorrectly installed. This problem is less likely to happen when you have NATE-certified technicians in charge of the installation.

Why does it matter if your heating or cooling system was incorrectly installed? Potential problems that result from incorrect installation include higher energy bills, less efficiency than the model is supposed to provide, short cycling, and failure to adequately cool or warm your house.

NATE-certified technicians follow the manufacturer’s instructions on installing the unit. They’ve received training in properly installing heating and cooling systems of various brands, so you can rest assured that they know what they’re doing.
Keener Eyes for Tuning Your Heating and Cooling Systems

Because NATE-certified technicians are more knowledgeable than technicians who don’t have NATE certification, they can notice problems during tune-ups that other techs may have missed. This will ensure your heating and AC tune-ups are as effective as possible. Quality heating and AC maintenance reduces how much money you’ll spend overall on these indoor comfort systems.

Yearly maintenance prevents serious breakdowns and extends the lifespan of your HVAC system. It also keeps monthly energy bills low. During maintenance, our technicians will thoroughly clean your appliance, lubricate moving parts, and tighten loose electrical connections. They’ll also inspect the system to ensure everything is working correctly. Sometimes, worn parts will need to be replaced to prevent a breakdown.
You’ll Save Money Overall

Heating and cooling systems are designed to last 10 to 15 years. It depends on the type of system as to how long it should last. Gas furnaces, for instance, can last 15 to 30 years when they’re taken care of. NATE-certified technicians will handle your appliances with care and expertise. They’re less likely than other technicians to make mistakes while working on your unit.

You’ll save money having your climate comfort appliances fixed correctly the first time. All components will also be properly installed right from the start. You won’t have to deal with frustrations if months later you find out a technician didn’t accurately diagnose and repair your system.
They Have an Incentive to Provide Quality Service
NATE certification needs to be regularly renewed. Thus, NATE-certified technicians have a strong incentive to stay knowledgeable as the industry changes in order to keep their certifications.

As technicians who take pride in their work, NATE-certified technicians provide good customer service as well. These high achievers want to keep you as a customer. They conduct themselves professionally, answer questions thoroughly, and strive to leave customers happy with the experience.
Turn to Us
